data_fields.name: corpse_loot_per_action
data_fields.donor_constant: all items (TransferAll); fix to one unit

best_idea: A death is a timed, input-locked beat (camera drops at a fixed speed, screen fades over 2 s, return after 3 s) and the enemy body stays as a lootable container that keeps its own items.
decision_why: Take the staged death beat as presentation for a Pit or world death so a loss reads without a penalty; keep the corpse as the loot container but take-one not take-all; fix the camera overshoot and the mixed clocks. The donor has no death penalty and no death respawn, so it is not a source for those.
acceptance: On death the camera drops and the screen fades to black over 2 s with input locked; after 3 s the player is returned to the title or the Pit end card; a server test asserts a looter takes one unit per action and the corpse keeps the rest.
